trigger: Pre-outcome implementation review found that the concentration stress selected ceil(10% of all trades) from the positive subset instead of ceil(10% of positive trades). The first economic workflow had already failed before producing a result_summary.json.

correction.old_rule: Remove up to ceil(total trade count * 10%) positive trades.
correction.new_rule: Remove exactly the largest ceil(positive trade count * 10%) positive trades, or none when no positive trade exists.
correction.reason: The registered gate is explicitly a top-10-percent-positive-trade removal test. Using total trade count can over-remove winners and falsely reject a viable fixed model.
correction.global_slot_reroute: Deferred unless a fit survivor exists; this fatal proxy uses the corrected conservative ledger-removal metric. Any survivor must receive exact event-key exclusion before global arbitration in the next frozen validation contract.

unchanged: dates, costs, funding, execution and stage gates
